name: Vector 24-Hour World-Class Benchmark
claimPolicy: Do not claim broad competitive superiority. A superiority claim may only be made for a named capability after the corresponding live evidence gate passes.

winningDimensions.target: Connect people, skills, certifications, availability, shifts, production demand, labour cost, compliance, outcomes and learning in one operational model.
A customer can move from signed contract to configured isolated environment, integrations, validated data, training and handover without routine human implementation work.
Discover, connect, map and continuously verify enterprise systems through reusable adapters and safe middleware-compatible patterns.
AI explains what matters, why it matters, recommended action, expected impact and can execute bounded approved actions with audit evidence.
Every savings claim separates identified opportunity from realised/verified value and links to source evidence.
Role-specific, task-first screens with no unnecessary information, no persistent horizontal overflow and a clear answer to 'so what?' on every data surface.
Fast self-service for leave, entitlement, shifts, availability, clocking and status with context before committing actions.
Optimise staffing against demand, skills, constraints, cost and productivity; extend to agency and energy decisions when evidence is available.
Trace payroll-ready outputs back to time/workforce evidence and reconcile expected simulation results without silent error.
Security, tenant isolation, performance, observability, accessibility, resilience and rollback are automated release gates rather than optional review steps.

releaseRule: Any failed release-blocking dimension prevents a world-class claim for that dimension. Unknown evidence is not a pass. CADDi parity/beat gates remain UNKNOWN or FAIL until live evidence exists; competitive comparison must never convert aspiration into a claim.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Ingest and structure ERP, PLM, MES, QMS, CRM, HR, finance, file-server and unstructured manufacturing data without requiring replacement of source systems.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Connect the same manufacturing data to workforce, skills, availability, time, labour cost, agency, compliance and payroll context.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Create traceable semantic relationships across products, parts, processes, defects, suppliers, prices, people and finance.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Extend the graph through worker, skill, certification, line, shift, attendance, labour cost, production output, energy, payroll and decision outcome.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Interpret drawings, BOMs, specifications and product data and identify reusable/similar manufacturing knowledge.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Use engineering/product similarity together with live workforce capability and production constraints to recommend what can actually be built, by whom, when, at what labour/energy cost and risk.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Search manufacturing knowledge across structured and unstructured sources.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: One search/AI layer answers engineering, workforce, production, cost, compliance and payroll questions with evidence links.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: AI agents analyse manufacturing data and perform bounded operational tasks.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Agents reason across engineering + workforce + production + finance, then execute permission-bound actions and measure downstream operational/financial outcomes.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Support design reuse, asset lifecycle, production readiness, design/cost review and quoting workflows.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Add labour readiness, workforce scheduling, skills, attendance, agency labour, payroll controls, energy and implementation/support automation to the same operating graph.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Capture decisions and outcomes so manufacturing knowledge compounds.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Learn the relationship between engineering choice, staffing choice, production result, quality, labour/energy cost and payroll outcome, then improve future recommendations.

caddiParityAndBeatGates.target: Demonstrate credible scale, security, reliability and customer value.
caddiParityAndBeatGates.vectorBeat: Pass enterprise WFM + manufacturing intelligence gates together, including 10,000 employees / 50 sites, payroll reconciliation, integrations, resilience and evidence-backed value.
